briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and DeepSeek-R2 push frontier performance while US export controls tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race accelerates with multiple frontier labs releasing upgraded models this month. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny intensify globally. US-China decoupling remains the dominant strategic dynamic.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships Orion-2 with major reasoning gains. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4. DeepSeek-R2 closes gap on Western leaders.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime defenses.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 1.6nm process for AI accelerators. Microsoft and xAI announce joint 200k H100-equivalent cluster. Power shortages delay two major US data center projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's frontier progress more than they accelerate domestic alternatives?
